The selected platform provider may read the conversation, selected files, results and progress used during the lesson.

Codex uses your OpenAI account; Cowork uses your Anthropic account. Saving files in a folder does not guarantee offline processing or exclude platform-managed retention. Vera does not send course materials, answers or progress to Mparanza and requires no voice service in Cowork. Any necessary public research follows the selected function’s boundaries. Moving to real data requires an explicit choice and normal permissions.
classes.purpose: Carry out learn-with-vera using the selected evidence and user instructions

local-onboarding.display_name: Local onboarding and repeatable voice-first teaching in native OpenAI desktop sessions

external_boundaries.content: Fixed public GET with ordinary connection metadata; no tutorial, profile, lesson, case, plugin-version or local-path content. Details are governed by plugin-update-check.
controls: Profile, lesson and feedback fields are never arguments to the version checker. Change-request status polling is suppressed while onboarding is unfinished/recovering or a teaching session is active/inaccessible; tutorial receipt stamping remains suppressed. A completed introduction with no active teaching session permits the ordinary prior-submission status route described separately below.
external_boundaries.purpose: Show published version updates independently of tutorial completion
external_boundaries.retention: Only the downloaded public manifest and check time are cached locally when plugin data storage is available. Hosted access-log retention is outside this helper.

external_boundaries.content: Only previously retained change-request IDs and their bearer status tokens, bounded to 100 per batch, plus ordinary connection metadata. No interview, profile, lesson, personal teaching feedback, tutorial files or submitted feedback text is sent by this status lookup.
controls: No local prior-submission receipts means no request. Unfinished or inaccessible onboarding and active or inaccessible teaching suppress this route. Polling does not create feedback or mark a lesson complete; the plugin-feedback register governs the bounded transport and response.
external_boundaries.destination: Mparanza HTTPS /api/change-requests/status through the existing plugin-feedback service
external_boundaries.purpose: Restore ordinary status notices for previously user-approved feedback when the introduction is complete and no teaching session is active.
external_boundaries.retention: Existing local plugin-feedback receipt state and Mparanza service retention apply. The onboarding helper does not set a new deletion policy.

external_boundaries.content: Fixed public GET paths for selected prepared assets, bound locally to exact SHA-256 values, plus ordinary connection metadata. No client files, local paths, teaching profile, answers, progress or feedback are sent.
controls: HTTPS and mparanza.com only, including redirects; no credentials or query parameters; passive lesson-data extensions only; 30-second request timeout and 25 MB cap; SHA-256 checked before atomic write; only selected-language attachments are fetched; no code is downloaded or executed.

The restored tax-litigation lesson is included in the prepared catalogue and packages. Vera attachments use existing language-file URLs whose bytes match each course SHA-256; restored immutable URLs remain available for older packages.
external_boundaries.purpose: Download reviewed fictional lesson data omitted from distributable packages when the user requests preparation.
external_boundaries.retention: Hash-verified lesson files stay in the selected local lesson folder. Website access-log retention is outside this helper.

security_controls.control: The stdlib helper retains a confirmed work/preferences summary, language, thread IDs, lesson evidence hashes and optional feedback only in the OS user local onboarding directory. It stores no audio and implements no network transport or hosted interview. The native OpenAI host sees the conversation and the local summaries/results it reads, under the ordinary OpenAI model-processing boundary. This also applies to local ChatGPT Work; the current register calls that OpenAI account boundary openai-codex, and does not certify cloud access to local files. Repeated teaching reads the same confirmed profile and saves each session separately, with a local example collection derived from those checkpoints. The profile is not copied into a hosted teaching service. A specifically requested first course can create its local session and native chat pair without a profile interview; the profile remains unset, and no introduction or understanding is marked complete. Existing introduction records are preserved. The optional Get started with Vera introduction reuses a single supported course and its separate practice; a short resume note stays beside the lesson outputs. It does not reset or complete the separate multi-course programme or introduce a model API, hosted interview or feedback recipient. The Patent Box kit supplies fictional software evidence and separate demo/practice ledgers. Rendering writes no approval or calculated result; actual selected files run through the same tutorial ledger. Historical synthetic rules and synthetic review cannot authorize real-client calculations; learner participation and understanding remain unconfirmed by fixture runs.
security_controls.on_violation: Permission errors, corrupt profiles and missing enrolled records require recovery only to resume the optional tutorial. Ordinary work continues without a profile check, server fallback, automatic reset or manufactured completion.

security_controls.control: Tutorial profiles, lesson artifacts and feedback remain local. Incomplete, inaccessible or active tutorials suppress CR polling; their receipts suppress stamping, including direct retries. Independently, startup may GET the fixed public version manifest with ordinary connection metadata and no tutorial content, installed version or local path, as recorded under plugin-update-check. It does not require a completed profile. Pause/rebind/resume revoke worker tokens for future bounded steps without claiming to cancel a running host command. Startup delegates only the fixed public version GET during unfinished/recovering onboarding or active/inaccessible teaching. After introduction completion with no active lesson, the ordinary previously receipted feedback status lookup may resume; no teaching material is submitted.
security_controls.on_violation: A tutorial receipt returns not_requested/local_onboarding before request construction; missing state leaves onboarding pending.

security_controls.control: Local exclusive save locks and revision checks prevent concurrent chat overwrites; separate enrollment detects a missing profile; lesson completion requires distinct demo/practice artifacts, replayed hashes and an explicit user-understanding attestation. Work and interests are assessed by the native model. Thread tokens coordinate one active lesson, not host authentication. Repeated demonstrations and guided attempts have separate evidence, stale-result checks and exact native thread tokens. A user-selected real-work handoff binds source hashes and a separate destination, rotates the token and refuses use of the tutorial adapter. Real professional execution retains its selected specialist data boundaries and approvals. Before lesson creation and worker dispatch, exact workflow IDs must belong to Vera's catalog and resolve to a skill inside the same installed Vera root. Worker responses identify that product, root and exact skill path; native teacher/worker instructions prohibit cross-product teaching.
security_controls.on_violation: Stale writes, wrong lesson handoffs or changed evidence are rejected without marking completion.

security_controls.control: The local loader supports both new teaching kits and explicitly retained published lessons. It verifies own-product identity, authored language, current source fingerprints and attachment hashes, then renders escaped HTML in a fresh ordinary directory without model calls. Repository course files remain local; distributable packages fetch missing hash-pinned fictional attachments through the prepared-course-download boundary. Both formats enumerate prepared artifact hashes; local progress checks reject those bytes even when copied or renamed. The working host must attest actual input, native-run and output files in the paired lesson. Hash and thread checks do not authenticate a host or prove semantic quality. Rendering performs no profile, understanding or execution-completion write. The static public catalogue contains prepared fictional materials and relative-only provenance, with no local execution requests, profile or progress files. Native OpenAI conversation is ordinary model processing, not offline inference. Browser preview is a separate optional local server: it binds only 127.0.0.1 on a free port, serves the rendered kit and relative assets, rejects resolved paths outside the kit and directory listings, and runs only for the lesson preview. It does not upload files, save access logs, change profiles or record completion. Browser/model inspection remains ordinary native model processing; loopback serving is not authentication against other local processes. XML, Markdown and text inputs have escaped reading views while execution keeps the original bytes. The optional results view checks the live execution record and input/output hashes, then renders selected CSV/text outputs in a fresh directory outside the sealed run. It retains source identities, performs no workflow execution or completion write, and uses only the same loopback preview and native model boundaries. PDF reading views render original pages locally with the already declared PyMuPDF dependency. Page images and an original-file download remain inside the lesson; the original PDF bytes remain the execution inputs. Rendering uses the declared prepared-course-download route for absent attachments and makes no model call.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject stale, foreign, altered or unavailable course material without fallback or lesson completion.

security_controls.control: Result Markdown links become local reading-page links only for exact absolute paths or exact output-relative paths of hash-verified Markdown, text, CSV or XML inputs recorded in that execution. Relative aliases are generated solely from that allow-list and the actual output directory; links do not discover or fetch files. Original input bytes are copied with a fresh hash check. Unrecorded paths, network URLs and active schemes remain inert text. Source reading pages escape file content and do not execute Markdown or HTML.
security_controls.on_violation: Input hash or path mismatch rejects the result view; unrecorded citation targets remain inert text.

security_controls.control: Hash-verified Word and workbook files have escaped local text/table reading views; original downloads retain exact bytes. Workbook readers disclose unavailable formula values without calculating invented values. Validated website results retain only the native hash-bound inventory of local HTML, CSS, image and font files and are served under a passive CSP sandbox that blocks scripts, forms, popups and external loads. The teacher may read these selected views in the native model context; no new hosted recipient, model call or automatic approval is introduced. Trasformazione lessons use a private synthetic component folder, without Studio Archive preparation or a transition to real client files; token and source/output identity checks still apply.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject changed or unrecorded files before serving the lesson result.

security_controls.control: Before teaching, instructions connect the existing shared course directory as the host workspace or request scoped host write access. The stdlib setup helper saves and reloads the real profile without advancing lessons or changing the saved revision. Temporary probes check create/read/write/update/replace/delete operations; state mutations and worker dispatch repeat checks for their actual directories. Diagnostics expose only the exact local paths, operation and native error to the selected host model. Grants are host-controlled; helpers neither change OS permissions nor infer successful access from an approval click. Existing profiles are not relocated or reset. No new network transport or external recipient is introduced.
security_controls.on_violation: Failed checks or saves pause course progression. The host obtains the exact folder access, retries with normal sandbox permissions and preserves existing progress. Ordinary professional work remains optional and available.

security_controls.control: The MCP App shows a readable native chat request with product, workflow, absolute course folder, teacher/worker references and a short-lived opaque invitation. These references enter the selected OpenAI account conversation; the worker claim returns the saved profile, lesson, exact installed skill path and bounded assignment to that same model runtime. No course input or output file bytes are attached to the chat request. The local bridge has no network calls and no Mparanza recipient. Folder access, revision, first unfinished lesson, product membership, thread pairing and invitation reuse are checked before execution. Only the teacher records progress; the host controls message confirmation and filesystem grants. Resume requests target the teacher, which reopens the saved working chat with native host tools. The invitation is a local coordination token, not host authentication or permission to bypass approvals.
security_controls.on_violation: Block stale, expired, replaced, duplicate or interrupted claims; return to the teacher and preserve course files and progress.

external_boundaries.content: Published shared package names and version constraints plus ordinary package-index request metadata. No client files, prompts, case data, credentials, or generated work are sent by this runtime installer.
controls: Only published shared core and explicitly selected OCR recipes are installed; package names are never derived from client material or prompts.

Host network denials stop package retrieval. Retry only the same declared setup after the host user or administrator authorizes registry access; never change host network settings or use an alternate installer to evade a denial.

Readiness probes the managed interpreter locally with isolated Python and site loading disabled, verifies CPython 3.12 and its platform against both receipt and policy, and validates common recipes and enabled features independently of the initial launcher.
All three products and their modules use the same environment. Optional OCR requires approval and is then retained in that environment. A shared environment is not a boundary between client matters.
external_boundaries.destination: Python Package Index (PyPI) or the package index configured for the active Python interpreter
external_boundaries.purpose: Prepare the published shared Vera, Clara and Lucia core requirements and explicitly approved optional OCR in one user-scoped Python 3.12 environment per operating-system host.
external_boundaries.retention: Packages remain in one fixed user-scoped environment outside plugin source and client folders until explicitly removed. The default location is ~/.local/share/mparanza/runtime/venv on macOS and Linux, and LOCALAPPDATA/mpr/venv on Windows; MPARANZA_RUNTIME_ROOT may override the parent. Enabled OCR remains enabled across later core updates. Package-index request-log retention is controlled by the configured index. Failed updates invalidate the readiness receipt and require repair before execution; this shared environment has no retained generations.

external_boundaries.content: The fixed CPython 3.12 version request, operating-system and architecture selection, and ordinary download request metadata. Setup does not read client files or add prompts, case material or generated reports to this request.
controls: Use an installed CPython 3.12 when available; otherwise use uv or automatically download the published uv 0.12.10 wheel, verify its pinned SHA-256, and provision private CPython 3.12 without changing system Python or shell profiles.
Probe the selected interpreter before creating the dependency environment; never fall back to executing workflows with another Python minor version.
A failed download or interpreter probe stops setup; existing environments and client files remain intact.
external_boundaries.destination: PyPI files.pythonhosted.org for the pinned uv bootstrap, and Astral python-build-standalone CPython distributions on GitHub
external_boundaries.purpose: Provision the single supported CPython 3.12 interpreter when it is absent, automatically bootstrapping uv if needed
external_boundaries.retention: When uv must be bootstrapped, the bootstrap executable and private interpreter remain inside shared runtime storage until removed. Download request-log retention is controlled by the providers.

external_boundaries.content: Random installation UUID and opaque capability, Vera/host/runtime versions, platform and workflow technical IDs, failed stage, complete available technical diagnostic chains and measurements, explicit missing-measurement reasons, retry IDs and actual recovery outcomes. No professional helper stdout, client documents, case text, user prompts or arbitrary task logs. Known path, email and credential patterns are removed from technical messages; this mechanical filter does not establish semantic privacy. The host agent must select technical evidence without unrelated personal/client material. The remote channel does not read local files. Failed helpers retain complete stderr privately on disk; stderr may include unrelated private/client text and is read by the selected host model for semantic review under its existing account. Raw stderr is not forwarded to Mparanza. Only reviewed relevant technical diagnostics, linked by the original report UUID, are submitted as supplemental evidence. Professional stdout is not captured. Managed helpers also send source-bound exception classes, OS error numbers, package-relative stack coordinates, developer-authored error templates and missing required option names automatically. Dynamic exception/argument values, locals, professional stdout and arbitrary source excerpts are not part of these structured events. Process-session UUIDs, persistent operation UUIDs and optional keyed digests of existing run/input-receipt identities bind attempts without disclosing receipt fields or raw client-input hashes. Actual worker interpreter/platform fields are separate from the reporter's interpreter. Capture completeness, pending semantic review, exact remedy/retry events and host verification of the original task remain distinct evidence states; a structured event is not a semantic diagnosis.
controls: Only closed technical transport schemas are accepted; unknown fields and arbitrary recovery commands are rejected.
The fixed HTTPS transport refuses redirects. Reporting failures retain the outbox and do not discard professional outputs.
The remote connector is independent of local command-process startup. If the host cannot expose/connect it, no successful report is claimed.
Only two built-in setup/preparation retries may execute automatically, once per remedy revision. Client documents, ACLs and security settings are not changed.
A published update is not recovery. The failed operation must actually execute successfully before that installation delivery closes.

Supplemental diagnostics require ownership of the original report and matching execution metadata; they are stored separately and cannot change the original report UUID, delivery status or remedy revision. Raw local diagnostic files can only be removed by acknowledging a matching recorded supplement.
Actionable remedies target an explicit original report. Each delivery uses its own applicable revision; a different report with the same generic signal does not inherit that remedy.

A cached actual connector status permits only the two fixed retries for an existing matching local receipt and latest report. It performs no direct HTTP polling or identity adoption. Missing local receipts cannot be fabricated to authorise a retry.

A helper success records readiness. Host AI verification of the original task and inputs is required for all recovered outcomes, including setup/startup. Delayed failures cannot reopen an already recovered episode.
Failed fixed retries retain complete stderr privately for semantic review. Raw recovery stderr is not automatically transmitted.

An explicitly selected MPARANZA_INCIDENT_DELIVERY=local-only setting blocks automatic client HTTP transport for this execution while preserving local evidence. Incident queues are durably marked and not automatically flushed later; this does not make model-provider processing local-only.
external_boundaries.destination: Mparanza HTTPS operational-incident API and Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint
external_boundaries.purpose: Diagnose observed execution/setup failures, return installation-specific remedies and receive actual recovery outcomes
external_boundaries.retention: Local capability, pending reports and receipts persist outside client folders. The service retains incident, report, remedy and outcome records; no automatic deletion period is enforced. Status access is scoped by the opaque capability. Pending diagnostic pointers and raw stderr persist in the private incident directory until a matching actual recorded supplementation receipt is acknowledged; unsuccessful review or delivery retains them. Supplementation never replaces the original recovery episode or reopens recovered records. Recorded original/outcome receipts can acknowledge only their exact local queued UUID without replacing the local capability or saved connector identity. Remedy revisions are retained from the surviving migration revision onward; overwritten legacy revisions are not reconstructed.

security_controls.control: Setup validates package-relative selections and installs the published shared recipe. No package names or dependency instructions are accepted from client documents.
security_controls.on_violation: An unknown module, missing requirements file, invalid target, or failed dependency validation stops the helper instead of executing it in a partial environment.

security_controls.control: One fixed environment is located outside plugin source and client folders. An exclusive operating-system installation lock waits for running managed Python readers, which hold a shared lease through a startup hook. Setup removes the ready receipt before mutation and restores it only after pip check and component validation. Failed setup leaves execution unavailable until repair. Symlink roots, locks and metadata are rejected. The installer is launched from base Python to avoid self-deadlock. This lease is concurrency protection, not a security sandbox. Other historical environments are not automatically deleted.
security_controls.on_violation: A target creation or validation failure returns a bounded setup error and the requested helper is not run.

security_controls.control: The Windows archive launcher probes a callable interpreter and package entrypoint without changing aliases, registry, execution policy or client folders. The archive helper checks package readability before setup and supplies an explicit task UUID to every managed archive command. Recovery requires reconnecting the selected existing archive root; tasks do not silently adopt each other's configuration. Diagnostics return bounded package/startup status rather than client documents.
security_controls.on_violation: An unreadable package or invalid session stops before runtime setup and archive commands.

security_controls.control: For the six explicitly supported assured modules, the launchers verify the complete package inventory and stable regular-file bytes against the embedded build-generated SHA-256 index. Symlinks, reparse entries, special files, extra directories/files, missing or changed code and unstable reads stop preparation. Unchanged hardlinked package code is materialized into a fresh private OS temporary directory; each copied file is re-read and must have one physical link, then the unchanged component integrity validator must pass. The managed installation and aliases are not modified. The copy contains indexed product code/assets, not client documents, credentials, workflow reports or dependency environments. This local index detects package drift; it is not a publisher signature, a signed origin attestation or proof of installed-host acceptance. Successful code copies remain in OS temporary storage for normal OS cleanup. The root-level host .in_use directory is non-executable bookkeeping: only ASCII numeric, ordinary single-link regular marker files are excluded from the product inventory. Nested directories, links, reparse points and non-numeric names there are rejected. Marker contents are not read, executed, transmitted or included in a recovery copy; host markers and installed product files are not modified.
security_controls.on_violation: Preparation failures and host permission denials stop execution. A failed private copy is removed; no installation chmod/unlink/manual repair, alternate sandbox or relaxed component validation is permitted.

security_controls.control: The parent Vera launcher reports a negative exit code or 137/247 as forced termination. It writes execution_failure.json only inside the selected workflow context output directory or its normalization/sample subdirectories; without that matching context it logs only. The diagnostic stores workflow/run identifiers, exit status and an explicit statement that memory exhaustion is not established by the exit code. It makes no model calls or network requests.
security_controls.on_violation: A worker failure remains failure; diagnostic persistence errors are logged rather than converted into a success.

security_controls.control: The standalone Python bootstrap passes uv only declared host paths, locale, proxy, CA and cache settings, preserving original environment-name casing. Unrelated token/API-key variables and inherited UV_*, VIRTUAL_ENV, CONDA_PREFIX, PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH are excluded; private UV_PYTHON_* and UV_CACHE_DIR values are set by the bootstrap. The same environment is used for interpreter discovery and its local probe.
security_controls.on_violation: Undeclared environment names are absent from every bootstrap child process.

security_controls.control: The built-in incident dependency-setup retry uses the shared host/runtime environment allowlist, named runtime/state locations and recovery recursion guard instead of inheriting unrelated user tokens and keys.
security_controls.on_violation: Undeclared environment names are absent from the child environment.

security_controls.control: When the maintained launcher itself runs under Python -I -B, it restores only its own resolved scripts directory for sibling technical-diagnostic imports. It does not add the caller working directory. Helper execution, diagnostic retention and explicit incident delivery policy remain unchanged.
security_controls.on_violation: The maintained launcher must stop rather than resolving technical diagnostics from the caller working directory.
